typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SiteGroup as string,
		SiteName as string,
		DataHall as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		EntID as string,
		WFGrid as string,
		AssetName as string,
		TotalRU as double,
		UnavailableRU as integer,
		InstalledRU as decimal(38,0),
		MarkedRU as decimal(38,0),
		ClosedRU as integer,
		StrandedRU as decimal(38,0),
		TotalConsumed as double,
		AbandonedRU as integer,
		AvailableRU as integer,
		FreeRU as integer,
		RUMAX as integer,
		PowerThreshold as double,
		PowerUsed as decimal(38,0),
		PowerFree as double,
		ReadyUnAssignedRU as integer,
		SpaceNoKW as integer,
		Powered2RUBlock as double,
		Powered3RUBlock as double,
		PoweredServerCounts as integer,
		PoweredDeviceCounts as integer,
		Lifecycle2 as string,
		DCMFlavor2 as string,
		ServiceCat2 as string,
		Ready2RUHoles as double,
		VerifiedRA as string,
		CWExclude as boolean,
		NlyteID as integer,
		Tag as string,
		CabinetUsage as string,
		RecordStatus as string,
		OperationalStatus as string,
		Status as string,
		PlanningNotes as string,
		SerialNumber as string,
		RFIDTag as string,
		HeatingLimit as double,
		HeatThreshold as double,
		CanBeAllocatedTo as boolean,
		UploadDate as date,
		ETLUser as string,
		Layer as string,
		Row as string,
		Column as string,
		Rotation as string,
		Xmm as double,
		Ymm as double,
		Xin as double,
		Yin as double,
		CabinetProfile as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource split((isNull(CWExclude)) && (SiteGroup != 'Virtual' && SiteGroup != '3-Sandbox Lab' && SiteGroup != '6-Admin'), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Case1 sink(input(
		AbandonedRU as integer,
		SiteName as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		WFGrid as string,
		CabinetUsage as string,
		HeatThreshold as double,
		ReadyUnAssignedRU as integer,
		PlanningNotes as string,
		RUMAX as integer,
		SiteGroup as string,
		PowerUsed as integer,
		PoweredDeviceCounts as integer,
		UnavailableRU as integer,
		DataHall as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		Lifecycle2 as string,
		RFIDTag as string,
		MarkedRU as integer,
		AvailableRU as integer,
		RecordStatus as string,
		Status as string,
		ServiceCat2 as string,
		TotalRU as double,
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CanBeAllocatedTo as boolean,
		EntID as string,
		FreeRU as integer,
		SpaceNoKW as integer,
		InstalledRU as integer,
		OperationalStatus as string,
		AssetName as string,
		Ready2RUHoles as double,
		CWExclude as boolean,
		ClosedRU as integer,
		StrandedRU as integer,
		VerifiedRA as string,
		PowerThreshold as double,
		SerialNumber as string,
		PoweredServerCounts as integer,
		DCMFlavor2 as string,
		TotalConsumed as double,
		NlyteID as integer,
		Powered3RUBlock as double,
		HeatingLimit as double,
		Tag as string,
		Powered2RUBlock as double,
		PowerFree as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		AbandonedRU,
		SiteName,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName,
		WFGrid,
		CabinetUsage,
		HeatThreshold,
		ReadyUnAssignedRU,
		PlanningNotes,
		RUMAX,
		SiteGroup,
		PowerUsed,
		PoweredDeviceCounts,
		UnavailableRU,
		DataHall,
		ETLUser,
		Lifecycle2,
		RFIDTag,
		MarkedRU,
		AvailableRU,
		RecordStatus,
		Status,
		ServiceCat2,
		TotalRU,
		UploadDate,
		CanBeAllocatedTo,
		EntID,
		FreeRU,
		SpaceNoKW,
		InstalledRU,
		OperationalStatus,
		AssetName,
		Ready2RUHoles,
		CWExclude,
		ClosedRU,
		StrandedRU,
		VerifiedRA,
		PowerThreshold,
		SerialNumber,
		PoweredServerCounts,
		DCMFlavor2,
		TotalConsumed,
		NlyteID,
		Powered3RUBlock,
		HeatingLimit,
		Tag,
		Powered2RUBlock,
		PowerFree),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
